{{Youmay|the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] cruiser|the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] exploration vessel}}
'''''Starveil''''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] cruiser assigned to routine hit-and-fade operations near [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. [[Jak Bremen]]'s first assignment after joining the Rebellion was as a security officer on the ''Starveil''.<ref name="TLCSB" />
